description: What visitors and crawlers see on every screen size. Pick with mode: render = First screen on phone, tablet and desktop in a real browser, and what crawlers without JavaScript get (default). Needs url. probe = A measurement script to run in the user's own browser tool. analyze = Analyse the results of that script. Needs url, results.

no_js.description: Optional: the probe result with JavaScript turned off, for an exact comparison.

results.description: One probe result per viewport, each with device set to phone, tablet or desktop.

url.description: Full address of the page, for example https://example.com/pricing.

name: layout
title: Layout and first screen
